历史也不会泄露。 Nginx 规则可在后台「设置 → 服务器加固」按安装路径直接复制。

text.tspan: notes, API docs, plans, retros. They are useful the day they are generated, stale two weeks later — nobody
updates them, nobody dares delete them. Notion is too heavy, docsify only renders, Git repos are hostile to
non-programmers, and "organize the docs" never makes it onto the schedule.

text.tspan: PHP execution lock, direct hits get 403, no server config required) and follows renames/deletes; the write
path uses flock-held transactions + atomic replace, double-submit tokens + daily rate limit (10/day) +
time trap + honeypot; optional SMTP notifications (new comments to the owner, replies to the person
replied to; with no SMTP host configured there is zero outbound traffic and send failures stay silent)
